verdict.rationale: Mastra documents registering agents and workflows on one Mastra server that you run locally, which covers the local-engine half of the story, though the evidence never says this is a single command. Nothing in the evidence describes workflow unit-testing utilities: Studio is an interactive interface and evals score agent runs, which are adjacent features rather than a test harness. missing for 10: an explicit single command to run the engine locally, a workflow unit-testing library, time-skipping support, mocked-step support, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a backend developer, one command runs the whole engine locally, and testing utilities let me unit-test workflows with time skipping and mocked steps

citations.quote: Register agents and workflows on one Mastra server, run it locally, and deploy the same app to Mastra Cloud.
